description: The changes in the watched tools, oldest first, 100 per page. Pass the cursor of the last call in `depois` to get only what is new. The same changes the account e-mail reports, while each tool was watched. Without `depois`, the last 30 days. Up to 100 per page: repeat with `depois` set to the `cursor` of the last response while `mais` is `true`. With nothing new, the answer keeps the same cursor, so poll with the last one. `email: true` means the account also gets these changes by e-mail.

depois.description: The `cursor` of the last response. Leave it out to read the last 30 days.
